item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day is full of reminders about pausing and choosing on purpose, and food is one of the easiest places to practice that. Eat at a table, not standing or scrolling. Notice hunger before you start, and notice when you're satisfied. Skipping meals because the day is busy usually leads to grabbing whatever is closest later. Plan one real meal now. Your action: before you eat next, take three slow breaths.
